solution: $\\ln\\tfrac{x^{2}}{x-2}=\\ln 8\\Rightarrow \\tfrac{x^{2}}{x-2}=8\\Rightarrow x^{2}=8x-16\\Rightarrow x^{2}-8x+16=0\\Rightarrow (x-4)^{2}=0\\Rightarrow x=4$. Domain requires $x>2$, so $x=4$ is valid.
hints: Combine the logarithms on the left.
Drop the logs and solve the resulting quadratic.
